resources.string: When you set up a new Android phone from this one, your meetings and saved voices are copied directly to it. Nothing is sent to a cloud account. Downloaded models are not copied; the new phone downloads them again.
Nothing is copied to a new phone. If this phone is lost or replaced, your meetings are gone unless you exported them.
Your meetings and saved voices are too large to move in one transfer. Export your meetings as a ZIP instead.
Future meetings will name this person automatically.
Name them again in a meeting to keep recognising them.
To add someone, name a speaker in any meeting and keep “Remember this voice” on.
Cassini stops recognising this voice. Names already in your meetings stay.

plurals.item: Cassini stops recognising %1$s saved voice and deletes the voiceprints from every meeting. Names already in your meetings stay.

resources.string: Meetings here are deleted for good after 30 days, with their audio, transcripts and voiceprints from those meetings.

Meetings you delete stay here for 30 days.
